Medicare says Original Medicare generally does not pay for routine cleanings, fillings, extractions, dentures or implants; exceptions may apply to dental services directly linked to certain covered medical treatments. Ask your dental or Medicare Advantage plan about the particular procedure rather than only whether the clinic accepts insurance.
